manifest.name: search-sieve
manifest.description: SearchSieve — a DeepSeek Harness tool plugin: sifts web search results against the user's question — selection ratio, answer completeness (expectedPoints or auto keywords), representativeness & redundancy — with a switchable pink/blue/white web coverage card and auto-evaluation after every web_search.
manifest.author: rangrongg

bundle.text:
# search-sieve bundle layer — applied when a profile lists this bundle
# (package.json declares `dsh.bundle.patch` pointing at this file).
#
# PITFALL: `name` is a PACKAGE NAME (resolved through the profile's node_modules
# or the installation fallback `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules`), NOT a
# relative path. `search-sieve` is this package's main entry (→ dist/index.js).
- insert:
    - id: search-sieve
      name: search-sieve

readme.section: 🔍 SearchSieve — 搜索结果覆盖度「筛子」
readme.text:
> 搜索完了，结果到底够不够？SearchSieve 帮你把搜索结果**筛**一遍：答得全不全、留得准不准、重复多不多，一张卡片全看清。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/search-sieve) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/rangrongg/SearchSieve)

**English** · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)

---

```sh
dsh plugin add search-sieve
```

装完重启 dsh web，下一次网络搜索后覆盖度卡片就会自动出现。需要 dsh web 0.1.0-rc.x 或更新版本。

- **三个指标一次说清** —— 选中占比（留了几条）、回答完整度（答全没有）、代表性与冗余（留得值不值、重不重），外加未覆盖要点和补搜建议，一张卡片全给你。
- **搜索完卡片自动来** —— 每次 `web_search` 结束，SearchSieve 自动接上评估，不用手动拼参数，覆盖度随手可见。
- **三套皮肤随意换** —— 粉白、蓝白、纯白三种卡片风格，展开卡片右上角一点就换，选择自动记住。
- **零模型开销** —— 纯规则算法，不调模型、不要 API key、确定性输出，快且透明。
- **中文原生态** —— 中文无需分词词典，按语义要点逐点核对，`expectedPoints` 传得越准，评估越到位。
- **边界全兜住** —— 空结果、零选中、提不出关键词，都有明确提示和建议，绝不崩溃。

随便发起一次网络搜索，结果里就会出现 SearchSieve 的覆盖度卡片——点一下折叠行展开详情：

| 粉白（默认） | 蓝白 | 白色 |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |  |

顶部大号百分比是**回答完整度**，旁边是覆盖等级徽标（覆盖良好 / 部分覆盖 / 覆盖不足）；下面三根进度条分别对应回答完整度、对全集代表性、信息冗余度；再往下是选中占比、结果数、评估要点，以及**未覆盖的信息点**和**建议**。
展开卡片后，右上角有个调色板按钮，点击在粉白 / 蓝白 / 白色之间循环切换，选完自动记住，下次还是它。

工具接受 `expectedPoints`（期望的回答要点）。你把"答到什么程度算好"说清楚，SearchSieve 就逐点核对给你看；不传也行，它会自动从问题里提取关键词。

```jsonc
{
  "query": "村上春树一共写了几本书",
  "expectedPoints": ["作品数量", "最新作品", "诺贝尔奖经历", "代表作书名"],
  "searchResults": [

返回示例（卡片渲染的就是它）：

```jsonc
{
  "selectionRatio": "50%",        // 留用 1/2 条
  "answerCompleteness": "50%",    // 4 个要点：命中 1、部分命中 2
  "representativeness": "62%",    // 留用页覆盖全集信息权重的 62%

```sh
git clone https://github.com/rangrongg/SearchSieve.git
cd SearchSieve
pnpm install        # 或 npm install
npm run build       # tsc 编译服务端 + esbuild 打包客户端

readme.section: 在仓库【父目录】把插件装进 profile
readme.text:
cd ..
dsh plugin --profile web add ./SearchSieve

cd SearchSieve
npm run web         # = npm run build && dsh web
```

浏览器打开 **http://127.0.0.1:3080**，启动日志出现 `[search-sieve] registered "search_sieve" — listed=true` 即注册成功。

> Windows PowerShell 报"禁止运行脚本"时，用 `dsh.cmd` / `npm.cmd` 代替。

> Done searching but not sure if the results are enough? SearchSieve **sifts** your search results for you: how complete is the answer, how well-chosen are the kept pages, how much do they repeat — all on one card.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/search-sieve) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/rangrongg/SearchSieve)

**中文** · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

---

```sh
dsh plugin add search-sieve
```

Restart `dsh web` and the coverage card will appear automatically after your next web search. Requires dsh web 0.1.0-rc.x or newer.

- **Three metrics at a glance** — selection ratio (how many results were kept), answer completeness (was the question fully answered), representativeness & redundancy (are the kept pages worth it, do they repeat) — plus uncovered points and re-search suggestions, all on one card.
- **Auto-evaluates after every search** — as soon as `web_search` finishes, SearchSieve chains in and evaluates the results. No manual argument assembly, coverage is always one glance away.
- **Three switchable skins** — pink, blue and pure white card styles, cycled with a click on the palette button in the expanded card; your choice is remembered.
- **Zero model overhead** — pure rule-based algorithm: no model calls, no API key, deterministic output. Fast and transparent.
- **Native Chinese support** — no tokenizer dictionary needed; verifies each expected point mechanically. The better your `expectedPoints`, the sharper the evaluation.
- **Edge cases fully covered** — empty results, nothing selected, no extractable keywords: you always get a clear message and actionable suggestions, never a crash.

Run any web search and a SearchSieve coverage card appears in the results — click the collapsed row to expand the details:

| Pink (default) | Blue | White |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |  |

The big percentage on top is **answer completeness**, with a verdict badge next to it (Good coverage / Partial coverage / Insufficient coverage). Below are three progress bars: answer completeness, representativeness of the full result set, and information redundancy. Then the stat grid (selection ratio, result count, points evaluated), followed by the **uncovered points** and **suggestions**.
Expand a card, find the palette button in the top-right corner, and click to cycle through pink / blue / white. Your selection persists.

The tool accepts `expectedPoints` — the facets you consider a good answer. Tell SearchSieve what "answered well" means and it verifies point by point; leave it out and it auto-extracts keywords from the query instead.

```jsonc
{
  "query": "How many books did Haruki Murakami write?",
  "expectedPoints": ["number of works", "latest work", "Nobel Prize", "representative titles"],
  "searchResults": [

Example output (this is what the card renders):

```jsonc
{
  "selectionRatio": "50%",        // kept 1 of 2
  "answerCompleteness": "50%",    // 4 points: 1 hit, 2 partial
  "representativeness": "62%",    // kept pages cover 62% of the full set's info weight

```sh
git clone https://github.com/rangrongg/SearchSieve.git
cd SearchSieve
pnpm install        # or npm install
npm run build       # tsc for the server half + esbuild for the client bundle

readme.section: Install the plugin into a profile from the PARENT directory
readme.text:
cd ..
dsh plugin --profile web add ./SearchSieve

readme.section: Back in the repo, start the web UI
readme.text:
cd SearchSieve
npm run web         # = npm run build && dsh web
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:3080** — a log line `[search-sieve] registered "search_sieve" — listed=true` means the registration succeeded.

> On Windows PowerShell, if you see a "running scripts is disabled" error, use `dsh.cmd` / `npm.cmd` instead.
